title: 2 Samuel
author: The author is not named; material is associated with Samuel, Nathan, and Gad according to 1 Chronicles 29:29.
date: Covers the reign of David over Judah and all Israel.
audience: Israel, showing both the blessing of God's covenant with David and the consequences of sin.
historicalSetting: Second Samuel records David's rise to the throne, God's covenant promise to him, his sin and repentance, and the troubles that followed in his house and kingdom.
keyVerse: 2 Samuel 7:16 — "Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you."
christFocus: The covenant with David points directly to Jesus Christ, the Son of David, whose kingdom is eternal and whose reign fulfills God's promise.
outline: The ark and God's covenant with David — 2 Samuel 6-7
Final reflections on David's reign — 2 Samuel 21-24
